# DAB Hands

> I help digital-forward businesses get their best work into the world, intact. Senior operational leadership for important work moving through complex organisations.

DAB Hands is the digital home of Darren Brett, a senior digital operator with the heart of a creative. Not a consultancy, not an agency, not a transformation practice. I am brought in when important work needs to keep moving through complexity, from focused operational leadership to longer-running support. Backed by more than 20 years helping global brands and tier-one agencies move important digital work from idea to market without losing momentum, quality or intent.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dabhands.delivery/): The proposition and point of view. The tools are changing, the problems aren't. Most organisations already have what they need; the challenge is helping it move together so it arrives as intended.
- [For Business & Agency Leaders](https://dabhands.delivery/business-and-agency-leaders): For leaders who need stronger movement across teams, partners, priorities and initiatives. Experienced operational leadership that understands delivery, commercial realities, people and how organisations actually work.
- [For Marketing Leaders](https://dabhands.delivery/marketing-leaders): For marketing leaders who need confidence that important work reaches customers without losing momentum, quality or intent. Helping the strongest ideas arrive with their clarity, confidence and ambition intact across campaigns, launches and experiences.
- [For Growth-Stage Businesses](https://dabhands.delivery/growth-stage-businesses): For founder-led, VC-backed and PE-backed businesses, scale-ups and digital-first brands where growth creates complexity faster than capability. Building the operating models, team structures and decision-making the next stage of growth depends on.
- [Contact](https://dabhands.delivery/contact): Reach out directly for important work that needs to move properly.
